messages:
mia: FYI ran a GPTQ+AWQ sweep overnight across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. Looking for rollout profile input.

raj: please drop the deltas and any notable regressions.

mia: short summary: GPTQ-4/6 kept accuracy closer to baseline for Llama and Mistral; AWQ-4 gave the biggest memory wins and sometimes slightly better p50 but Qwen had instruction-following regressions on AWQ and GPTQ-4.

sachin: paste numbers

mia: raw harness snippet (small eval set):
```
models: Llama-2-13B | Mistral-7B | Qwen-7B
quant-modes: fp16 (baseline), gptq-4bit, gptq-6bit, awq-4bit
metrics: ppl (LM), instr_acc, latency_p50(ms), latency_p95(ms), mem_peak(GiB)

Llama-2-13B:
  baseline: ppl 11.2, instr_acc 0.86, p50 45, p95 120, mem 34.2
  gptq-4:  ppl 11.5, instr_acc 0.85, p50 48, p95 130, mem 9.1
  gptq-6:  ppl 11.3, instr_acc 0.86, p50 46, p95 125, mem 13.6
  awq-4:   ppl 12.0, instr_acc 0.83, p50 44, p95 118, mem 7.8

Mistral-7B:
  baseline: ppl 9.8, instr_acc 0.88, p50 30, p95 90, mem 20.6
  gptq-4:  ppl 10.1, instr_acc 0.88, p50 32, p95 100, mem 6.0
  gptq-6:  ppl 9.9, instr_acc 0.88, p50 31, p95 95, mem 8.9
  awq-4:   ppl 10.6, instr_acc 0.86, p50 29, p95 88, mem 5.4

Qwen-7B:
  baseline: ppl 10.9, instr_acc 0.84, p50 40, p95 115, mem 22.1
  gptq-4:  ppl 11.6, instr_acc 0.81, p50 43, p95 130, mem 6.9
  gptq-6:  ppl 11.1, instr_acc 0.83, p50 41, p95 120, mem 11.4
  awq-4:   ppl 12.4, instr_acc 0.78, p50 39, p95 110, mem 5.0
```

emily: AWQ looks great for memory but worry about Qwen instr drops and hallucinations.

mia: RLHF probe flagged omission/hallucination patterns for Qwen AWQ; we'll produce a prioritized fail list by intent cluster (summarization, numeric extraction, code reasoning).

sachin: suggested rollout profiles:
- small-instance routes: awq-4 for Mistral and Llama by default
- instruction-critical routes: gptq-6 (safer accuracy)
- canaries: 5% for Llama gptq-4, 2% for Qwen gptq-4/awq-4
- auto-failover: if instr_acc_delta <= -0.015 on canary vs baseline, revert to gptq-6 or baseline

raj: add instr_acc_delta and hallucination_rate metrics to console dashboard; automate canary rollback check.

mia: bakebot uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-bakes/gptq-run-20260318-7789/ (csv + diffs). I'll open a PR with the canary config + sample fail-list in ~45m.

bakebot: Bake complete: artifacts at s3://redwood-bakes/gptq-run-20260318-7789/; diffs/sample_fails.csv

emily: can we get the top 20 failing prompts for Qwen AWQ prioritized by impact? want to share with QA.

mia: yes — will attach cluster labels and example prompts in the PR. Ping me if you want the raw CSV. :thumbsup:
